subject: science

concepts.title: Mirror Formula
concepts.definition: In brief, a mathematical relation connecting the object distance, image distance, and focal length for any spherical mirror.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, Relates distances of object and image from the pole to the mirror's focal length.
question_patterns: find the position of the image
at what distance should the screen be placed
determine where the image is formed

solution_steps.action: Calculate the reciprocal of the focal length
Calculate the reciprocal of the object distance
Find the reciprocal of the image distance

concepts.title: Magnification of Mirrors
concepts.definition: In brief, in brief, the ratio of the image's height to the object's height, which also relates to the distances from the mirror.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, In brief, Indicates how much larger or smaller the image is compared to the object.
question_patterns: calculate the size of the image
what is the height of the image
determine the nature and size of the image

concepts.title: Lens Formula
concepts.definition: In brief, a mathematical expression relating the object distance, image distance, and focal length for spherical lenses.
concepts.key_idea: Determines image position for lenses using the Cartesian sign convention.
question_patterns: find the image distance for the lens
calculate where the image is formed
at what distance should the object be placed
determine the focal length of the lens

concepts.title: Power of a Lens
concepts.definition: In brief, In brief, In brief, a gauge of the degree of convergence or divergence of light rays, equal to one divided by the focal length in meters.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, Power is measured in dioptres (D) when focal length is in meters.
question_patterns: calculate the power of the lens
find the focal length from power
what is the power of a lens with given focal length

solution_steps.explain: P = 1 / f (where f is in meters)

worked_examples.question_pattern: radius of curvature is {R} and object distance is {u}, find position of image

questions: Find the focal length of a convex mirror whose radius of curvature is 32 cm.
A concave mirror produces three times magnified real image of an object placed at 10 cm. Where is the image located?
Find the power of a concave lens of focal length 2 m.
